question: By what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
To find the percentage difference, we first need to calculate the cost per kg of gain for the control group and T1.

Cost per kg of gain for the control group = 210.00 Rs
Cost per kg of gain for T1 = 169.94 Rs

Percentage difference = ((210 - 169.94) / 210) * 100
= (40.06 / 210) * 100
= 0.191 * 100
= 19.1%

So, the cost per kg of gain in T1 was 19.1% lower than in the control group.
